Welcome to the Street Fighter 6 Wiki!

Street Fighter 6 is the latest entry in the franchise, featuring a cast of returning veterans reimagined and all-new characters.

You can create an account to help edit this wiki on your own, and you can also join the Street Fighter 6 Resource Hub Discord Server for meta discussion about this wiki.

Character Pass
The following characters will join Street Fighter 6 as part of Year 4:
Yasmine: August 3rd, 2026

Arjun: October 13, 2026

Tifa: Early 2027

Bosch: Spring 2027

The following characters joined Street Fighter 6 as part of Year 3:

Sagat: August 5th, 2025

C. Viper: October 15th, 2025

Alex: March 17, 2026

Ingrid: May 28, 2026

The following characters joined Street Fighter 6 as part of Year 2:

M. Bison: June 26th, 2024

Terry: September 24th, 2024

Mai: February 5th, 2025

Elena: June 4th, 2025

The following characters joined Street Fighter 6 as part of Year 1:

Rashid: July 24th, 2023

A.K.I.: September 27th, 2023

Ed: February 27th, 2024

Akuma: May 22nd, 2024

General roadmap

edit

See a full overview of wiki progress on the Roadmap page.

In Progress / Completed
To-do

Finished move data (as of Patch 2.00 )

Finished Overview pages (up to Mai's release) with hitbox images, move descriptions, and all relevant info from Data pages

Finished General pages (Offense, Defense, Movement, Game Data, Gauges, etc.)
Can still be expanded upon, especially with more advanced strategies/techniques

Combo Pages
Add any missing combos or categories, ensuring all data is correct on the current patch

Try to ensure consistent formatting across all pages, ensuring mobile-friendly layouts

Strategy Pages
Ensure all major sections have at least basic info

Finish all Oki Tables (look for safe jumps, safejab setups, meaty overheads, DI-safe buttons with frame advantage, etc)

Matchup Pages
Add some info to all matchups (e.g. important punishes and general gameplan)
